body: Photorealistic commercial poster of a glass strawberry jam jar floating in mid-air, glossy red jam, black lid, cream label facing camera reading exactly "BERRY DAY". A jam splash arcs around the jar with whole and sliced strawberries and green leaves; keep label unobscured. Behind it, a simple generic smartphone social-feed frame with neutral icon shapes, no third-party logos or extra words. Red-orange gradient backdrop, macro commercial lighting, portrait 4:5.
